title: Pradhan Mantri National Dialysis Programme (PMNDP) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Government programme supporting dialysis services for eligible patients through public health facilities; it is a treatment-support programme rather than conventional insurance.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Patients requiring dialysis who access participating public facilities under applicable state/facility eligibility and programme rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Pradhan Mantri National Dialysis Programme (PMNDP).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
